0.0.n: This is the first part of the name しまじろう, not a separate word here.

0.1.n: This completes the name しまじろう; the speaker is addressing him directly.

0.3.n: This makes the planned errand sound brief and casual.

0.4.n: 2階 is read にかい and names the floor where the ironing will happen.

0.5.n: で marks where an action takes place, here the ironing.

0.6.n: アイロンをかける means to iron clothes; the object marker を is omitted in this casual speech.

0.7.n: かける becomes かけて and joins くる, showing an action done away from here before returning.

0.8.n: から gives the reason for the request in the next line.

1.0.n: This is the name of the child Shimajiro is asked to watch.

1.1.n: ちゃん follows a name to show affection, especially when addressing or mentioning children.

1.2.n: 見てて shortens 見ていて, a casual request to keep watching or looking after someone.

1.3.n: ね softens the request and invites agreement.

2.0.n: うん is an informal affirmative response used with people you know well.

2.2.n: The plain past form of 分かる acknowledges that the instruction has been understood.

3.0.n: The plain past form of 出る excitedly announces that someone has appeared.

3.2.n: 正義 describes the ideal the pretend hero represents.

3.3.n: の links 正義 to ヒーロー, describing what kind of hero he is.

3.4.n: This English loanword refers to the heroic character in the pretend adventure.

3.6.n: This begins the name しまじろう within the vehicle name しまじろう号.

3.7.n: じろう completes しまじろう, and 号 is a suffix attached to vehicle names.

3.8.n: で marks the vehicle used for the journey.

3.9.n: This noun stands alone as an excited announcement of setting off.

0.lit: Shimajiro, since I'll go do some ironing on the second floor and come back.
0.tip: An action's て-form plus くる can mean going away to do it and then returning.

1.tip: 見てて is short for 見ていて and asks someone to keep watching or looking after another person.

2.tip: 分かった is past tense in form but naturally means you understand the instruction now.

3.lit: Appeared! Hero of justice, departure in the Shimajiro vehicle!
3.tip: 号 attaches to a name to turn it into a vehicle name.
